status_meaning: Specified means an implementation contract exists. No runtime/parser/sandbox/hardware certification is claimed.
evidence_limits: Argument facts are lexical extraction, not complete overload constraints.
Runtime object field mutability and absent IPC surfaces remain unknown until proven.
Documentation candidate rows and independently versioned components require classification and source certification.
All dependencies, syscall/runtime profiles and empirical budgets require implementation build/test artifacts.

SCALAR.algorithm: Typed edit reducer; minimal expression patch or owned generation; version-certified scalar setter/publication
SCALAR.validation: Type/bounds/maps/special grammar, patch reparse, isolated parser, source-defined normalized readback

MONITOR.algorithm: Logical/physical topology model; typed monitor declaration; isolated mapping and guarded hardware apply

DEVICE.algorithm: Per-device override graph; exact field table; XKB/curve/region editor; device-targeted activation

WORKSPACE.algorithm: Typed selector/declaration and layout options; preserve workspace identity versus display name
WORKSPACE.validation: Filter existence, target mapping, layout-specific options and ordered runtime effects

RULE.algorithm: Ordered predicates/effects; static/dynamic and named/anonymous precedence; owned replacement/reload
RULE.validation: Exact effect/match grammar, conflict/precedence fixtures and observed outcomes

BIND.algorithm: Physical/symbol key forms, modifier/device/submap conditions, ordered actions and escape transitions
BIND.validation: Key conversion, conflict intersections, flag combinations and focus-bounded recorder

GESTURE.algorithm: Identity tuple plus tagged action or start/update/finish workflows; replace/unset identity explicitly
GESTURE.validation: Direction/fingers/mod/scale/variant checks; callback simulation versus physical test distinguished

ANIMATION.algorithm: Tree inheritance, duration/style/curve graph and source-version alias printer
ANIMATION.validation: Strict curve bounds, accepted styles, required enabled-node fields and deterministic scene

WORKFLOW.algorithm: Closed typed nodes and variant forms; transitive effect set; owned lifecycle handles; AST compiler
WORKFLOW.validation: Branch/argument conformance, lifetimes, optional targets, effect and operation budgets

INSPECTOR.algorithm: Whitelisted IPC or local typed filter; unknown where introspection is unavailable
INSPECTOR.validation: Sampled interval, target generation, bounded reply/event parsing and field mutability classification

LEGACY.algorithm: Lossless directive-specific grammar and separately versioned migration to typed action/declaration
LEGACY.validation: Suffix/context/variable/include semantics and target-format support; no execute on import

COMPONENT.algorithm: Exact-version adapter parse/serialize/activate/verify; documentation row classification required
COMPONENT.validation: Independent component schema/source/watch behavior, private preview and restore contract

STARTUP.algorithm: Owned launcher/environment source; stage next-session installation; never write active files as draft
STARTUP.validation: Launch ownership, config precedence, special FD restrictions and startup-only effects
